svg.text: Farm Connect — Backend Error Handling & Fault Resilience
Exception boundaries, 404 handlers, database pool crash guards, and production message sanitization

g.text: CENTRALIZED ERROR DISPATCH PIPELINE
1. Controller Try / Catch Wrapper
• Every async route controller is wrapped in try { ... } catch (error) { next(error); }
• Catches unhandled Promise rejections and SQL execution failures
• Forwards error object down the Express middleware stack to next()
authController.js #L74
2. Catch-All 404 Route Handler
• Mounted after all valid /api/v1 routes: app.use((req, res) => { ... })
• Intercepts typos and deprecated API endpoints
• Returns structured JSON with HTTP 404 status:
{ success: false, error: { code: 'ROUTE_NOT_FOUND', message: ... } }
backend/src/app.js #L100
3. Global 500 Error Middleware (app.use((err, req, res, next)))
• 4-argument signature signals Express this is the terminal error catcher
• Asynchronous Safety: Removed synchronous fs.writeFileSync to avoid
blocking the Node.js single-threaded event loop under production load
• Production Sanitization: Masks database stack traces from external callers
message: isProd ? 'Internal Server Error' : (err.message || ...)
• Returns standardized HTTP 500 response payload
backend/src/app.js #L110
4. Standardized JSON Error Contract
• Guarantees every error returns predictable format to client:
{ success: false, error: { code: 'SERVER_ERROR', message: ... } }
• Frontend Axios Interceptor reads error.message or code
• Triggers UI toast notification or user error display
DATABASE & HARDWARE FAULT ISOLATION
1. PostgreSQL Pool Crash Safety
• Idle Client Listener: pool.on('error', (err, client) => { ... })
• If a socket disconnects abruptly on an idle client, node-postgres calls this
• Prevents unhandled background exception from silently crashing Node.js
• Logs: "❌ Unexpected error on idle client" and safely exits process
• Process supervisor (Render container) immediately restarts instance
src/config/db.js #L20
2. Startup Connection Pre-Flight
• testConnection() executes SELECT NOW() on boot before accepting HTTP
• Fails loudly if DATABASE_URL is malformed or database is unreachable
• Prevents "half-started" zombie servers that accept requests but fail on queries
• Prints actionable error message: "Check DATABASE_URL in .env"
• Explicit process.exit(1) triggers immediate deployment rollback
backend/database.js
3. Atomic Transaction Rollback
• executeTransaction(callback) in backend/src/config/database.js
• If order insert or stock decrement throws error midway in order.service.js:
await client.query('ROLLBACK'); // Undoes all changes
• Prevents phantom deductions where stock drops but no order is created
• finally { client.release(); } guarantees connection is returned to pool
backend/database.js
4. Fast2SMS Third-Party Gateway Fallback
• If Fast2SMS credit runs out or external API is down:
• Catches axios error, logs message, returns false cleanly
• Controller responds with user-friendly 400: "Failed to send OTP"
• Developer bypass (OTP_DEMO_MODE=true) enables offline development
smsservice.js #L41
